title: Event callbacks
description:
Register C-style callbacks with a user-data pointer.

```
button clicked -> counter now 1
button clicked -> counter now 2, logger wrote "click 2"
```
hints: `static_cast<int*>(userData)` gets the counter back; the caller must make sure the pointer still points at something alive (lesson 3.05).
A captureless lambda converts to a function pointer: `subscribe([](void* d, int) { ++*static_cast<int*>(d); }, &counter);`.
requirements: A list of `(Callback, void*)` pairs; `subscribe` and `fire`.
Two callbacks with different user data: an `int` counter and a `Logger` struct, cast back from `void*` with `static_cast`.
stretch: Do the same with `std::function` and a capturing lambda, and compare.
